tone_preservation.gold_notation_mismatch_explanation: Hill & Gong (2020) encode Proto-Burmish tones as abstract etymological category numerals (¹ Tone 1, ² Tone 2, ³ Tone 3, ⁴ checked stop-coda category) and Old Burmese proxy forms use ³ ⁴ ⁵ or unmarked open syllables, whereas all 7 modern leaf lexicons carry Chao pitch-contour superscripts (⁵⁵, ⁵¹, ³⁵, ³³, ³¹, ²², ²¹, plus Rangoon ⁴). Gemini preserved 100% of tonal contrasts using daughter-grounded contour symbols (*⁵¹ ≈ gold ¹, *³⁵/*⁵⁵ ≈ gold ²/³, *³¹/*⁵⁵ ≈ checked ⁴), yielding 0/54 and 0/37 literal string/unit exact matches (with 3/54 and 1/37 segment-only exact matches) while capturing corpus-wide contrast structure in R06 corpus_bcubed_f1 (0.425184 at proto_burmish, 0.416361 at burmic).

preglottalized_and_voiceless_sonorants.diagnosis: Witness retention carried Maru creaky vowels (a̱, ɛ̱, i̱, u̱, ɔ̱) through maruic and Achang voiceless sonorants (m̥, n̥, ȵ̥, ŋ̊) through burmic, allowing min_attested_children=2, min_support=1 at proto_burmish to surface all 5 ['N', 'N̥'] and 6 ['V̱', 'V'] correspondences. However, Gemini committed only support>=2 patterns at proto_burmish (capturing *ɛ̱ on support=3) and treated onset and nucleus columns segment-by-segment rather than synthesizing cross-column *ˀm, *ˀn, *ˀŋ.

morpheme_boundary_plus_commits.diagnosis: At maruic, Gemini over-retained 4 single-daughter '+' boundary patterns (77 sets) + 2 multi-daughter '+' patterns (4 sets) = 81 '*+' sets before calling min_attested_children=2 on Turn 18, inflating compound forms with multiple '+' tokens (e.g., 1007 COW, 1248 EYE, 2378 THUNDER) that then propagated into proto_burmish via retain_from_witness='maruic' despite proto_burmish committing 0 '*+' sets.
